observations.content: User provided context-only preparation packets 1–8 of 12 for a later implementation task; no implementation action was requested in those packets.

Historical requirements specify that observer and consolidator workers must run with their owning session’s `.memory/<sessionId>/` root as cwd, using the runtime-resolved root and ensuring it exists before spawn, including fresh sessions; preserve model, prompt, environment, result handoff, cancellation, and exit handling.

The observational-memory project is a pi extension with a master orchestrator and ordinary headless recorded pi worker sessions; observers parallelize fixed token-bounded conversation chunks and commit minimal timestamp/content observations into a branch-local ledger, while deterministic compaction renders journey, memory map, observations, and a verbatim tail.

Phase B is implemented in the supplied project reference: a consolidator promotes oldest active observations into session-scoped `.memory/<sessionId>/` topic files and JOURNEY.md, then the orchestrator tombstones the handed batch intersected with still-active observations; long-term files do not roll back under `/tree`.
Long-term session memory uses the immutable session-header ID; `ensureSessionMemory` seeds a fork/clone from its parent once, excluding transient `.runs/`, while existing roots are never reseeded.
Workers hand off costs from pi’s built-in `usage.cost.total` through per-run cost files; `om.cost` is summed across all session entries/branches and does not roll back under `/tree`.
The per-session `/om` gate defaults OFF; `/om`, `/om on`, and `/om off` persist `om.enabled` in the ledger. Passive mode is a separate trigger-disable setting.

Project defaults in README/config excerpts differ from PLAN’s earlier defaults: current `src/config.ts` has chunkTokens 10000, poolTargetTokens 10000, consolidateAtPoolTokens 15000, compactAtContextTokens 100000, tailTokens 20000, journeyTargetTokens 1000, observerConcurrency 4, and OpenRouter `z-ai/glm-5.2` low/medium models.

Supplied source excerpts include consolidated worker prompts/tools, scoped consolidator filesystem tools, runtime/launch/IPC and ledger code, compaction wait fast-path and cutoff snapping, timeline/status UI, and tests for cutoffs, consolidation tools, costs, IDs, and ledger folding.
